claims.text: Experiments were performed on the CoinCollector text-based game, where the objective is to find and collect a coin from connected rooms.
Text-based games are used as a testbed for language understanding and problem-solving by artificial agents.
The methodology discussed involves using the Go-Explore algorithm to solve text-based games with large action spaces.
